data.long_meaning: Mohandas is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Mohan,' meaning 'delight,' and 'daas,' meaning 'servant.' This name symbolizes a devoted servant of God, who finds joy and delight in serving the divine. Parents who choose Mohandis usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
